== Summary ==
Original slip, 30 May 2003: Visored Vision (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 30 May 2003 sheet for [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; PDF on theforce.net, Internet Archive capture 1 August 2003), page 2, slip 23. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Visored Vision (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Original)]].
